authority.vault_root: resolved by PCCStoragePaths; environment override first, configured D:\CortexLibrary when available, safe local fallback otherwise
authority.project_mirror: content-addressed incremental SHA-256 object store with per-project snapshot manifests

rust.target_dir: project-namespaced under shared Vault build root to avoid executable collisions
rust.sccache: shared cross-project compiled cache when installed

mirror_policy.include: durable project source, content, configuration, documentation, control metadata and artifacts
mirror_policy.git_history: Git bundle mirrored when repository is initialized
mirror_policy.full_gate: a Vault mirror snapshot is required before issuing the FULL GREEN source marker

safety.automatic_cas_delete: never; purge requires explicit --yes after quarantine staging

certification.python_control_plane: must pass locally before handoff; lifecycle/GC tests included
certification.cargo_windows_build: not certified until user runs Windows FULL QUALITY GATE
certification.runtime_gui: not certified until user launches/tests GUI

lifecycle.snapshot_certification: FULL GREEN writes a separate certification record only after source marker succeeds
lifecycle.retention: 20 certified + 8 working snapshots per project by default; planning is read-only; apply is explicit
lifecycle.cas_gc: global mark-and-sweep across all retained project metadata
lifecycle.gc_safety: unreferenced objects are staged to reversible Vault quarantine before any explicit purge
lifecycle.health: PCC reports Vault disk, CAS size, shared store sizes, mirror health, reclaim candidates, and GC eligibility
